<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the given molecule, adds a TBS protecting group (i.e., the forward reaction breaks the O‑Si bond, forming an aliphatic hydroxyl and removing a t‑butyldimethylsilyl group). We'll search the template catalog for forward reactions that break a “t-butyldimethylsilyl” group and form an “aliphatic hydroxyls” group, using the provided SMILES as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
